method: Exact hash-pinned original function slices in Node VM; DOM/CSS, measurements, parent-panel layout, event action bodies and animation queue are explicit dependency stubs. No original app/GUI/browser rendering.

results.name: ordinary resize and alignment move expose intermediate geometry
both flags false perform no work
fractional sizes and right bottom moves remain unrounded
both zero updates CSS but does not replace logical size cache
both zero also retains a previous nonzero logical cache
one zero axis is cached when other is nonzero
negative requested dimensions are not clamped by query resize
pure owner rotation does not rotate alignment movement
resize handler mutation is observable before alignment correction
repeater fits at resized old position but not after direct alignment move
fixed repeater disables automatic row fit
panel parent stops direct traversal to repeater
hidden owner still resizes and fires synthetic events; fit excludes hidden owner
disabled flag does not suppress resize/move synthetic event names
table cell rejects resize but alignment move still executes
SVG child scales from old size with raw fractional ratio
SVG zero old axis produces unguarded infinite scale

limitations: CSS stub records assignments; does not model browser clamping, used boxes, 1/64 quantization or border-box minimums
Height/width measurements are injected, not font measurements
Synthetic event dispatcher is original; handler body is a synchronous snapshot/mutation stub, not full case/menu/Wait execution
Repeater fit dispatch is original; child bounds and row-size sink are stubbed, not original push layout
No general transform, fixed panel/layer wrapper DOM, image offsets, parent panel full resize or SVG rendering is probed
